bash chunk. R chunks run from the top of the repository.
-->

Completeness and contamination of each bin, estimated with CheckM, and selection of the most complete bins for further analysis. Commands for this step were run in `checkm/`.
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Change directory to checkm to check the bin quality 
```{bash}
cd checkm
```
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Read the Flye assembly FASTA file, extracts the length and name of each contig using bioawk, and sorts the contigs by length in ascending order.

```{bash}
cat ../flye/bbd/assembly.fasta | bioawk -c fastx '{print length($seq),$name}' | sort -n
```
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Extracts the DNA sequence of contig_121 from the assembly FASTA file using samtools faidx and saves it as a separate FASTA file in the bins_bbd directory. (We are choosing the biggest contig)

```{bash}
samtools faidx ../flye/bbd/assembly.fasta contig_121 > ../metabat/bins_bbd/contig_121.fa
```
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Copies all .fa FASTA files from ../metabat/bins_bbd/ into the current directory's bins_bbd/ folder.

```{bash}
cp ../metabat/bins_bbd/*.fa bins_bbd/
```
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Create a shell script with the name 'run_checkm_bbd.sh' and type this code 
```{bash}
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --time=60
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=6 --mem=40gb

echo "Starting checkm in $(pwd) at $(date)"

shopt -s expand_aliases
alias checkm='apptainer run -B /pvol/:/pvol /pvol/data/sif/checkm.sif checkm'

checkm lineage_wf bins_bbd out -t 6 -x fa -f checkm_results_bbd.txt

echo "Finished checkm in $(pwd) at $(date)"
```
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Run this script using sbatch command to access the HPC using slurm as an intermediate 

```{bash}
sbatch run_checkm_bbd.sh
```
